examples.en: The teacher warned us not to run near the pool.
examples.zh: 老師警告我們不要在泳池旁奔跑。

examples.en: The weather report warns that a typhoon is coming this weekend.
examples.zh: 氣象報告提醒本週末將有颱風來襲。

examples.en: I warned him that the sale would end soon, but he still missed it.
examples.zh: 我提醒他特價活動快結束了，但他還是錯過了。

examples.en: She rubbed some wax on the old wooden table.
examples.zh: 她在舊木桌上擦了一些蠟。

examples.en: The candle was made of natural wax.
examples.zh: 這支蠟燭是用天然的蠟做成的。

examples.en: Wax dripped down the side of the candle.
examples.zh: 蠟油沿著蠟燭的側面滴下來。

examples.en: Dad waxes the car every few months.
examples.zh: 爸爸每隔幾個月就會幫車子打蠟。

examples.en: We waxed the floor before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到達之前，我們先把地板打了蠟。

examples.en: He waxed his skis before the race.
examples.zh: 比賽前他幫滑雪板上了蠟。

examples.en: A bad cold can weaken your body.
examples.zh: 重感冒會使你的身體變虛弱。

examples.en: The storm weakened as it moved inland.
examples.zh: 暴風雨移入內陸後逐漸減弱。

examples.en: Too much noise may weaken your ability to focus.
examples.zh: 太多噪音可能會削弱你的專注力。

examples.en: The wealthy man donated money to the local school.
examples.zh: 那位富有的男士捐錢給當地的學校。

examples.en: She comes from a wealthy family in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她來自台北的一個富裕家庭。

examples.en: Wealthy countries can help poorer ones by supporting education and health care.
examples.zh: 富裕國家可以透過支持教育與醫療來幫助較貧窮的國家。

examples.en: Grandma weaves baskets from dried grass to sell at the local market.
examples.zh: 奶奶用乾草編織籃子，拿到當地市場販售。

examples.en: The workers weave cloth by hand in this village.
examples.zh: 這個村子的工人用手工織布。

examples.en: She wove a flower crown for her little sister.
examples.zh: 她替年幼的妹妹編了一個花冠。

examples.en: A spider built a web in the corner of the room.
examples.zh: 一隻蜘蛛在房間角落結了網。

examples.en: You can find the information on the web.
examples.zh: 你可以在網路上找到這項資訊。

examples.en: The morning dew made the web shine.
examples.zh: 晨露讓蜘蛛網閃閃發亮。

examples.en: Weeds are growing all over the garden.
examples.zh: 整座花園都長滿了雜草。

examples.en: We pulled the weeds out of the flower bed.
examples.zh: 我們把花圃裡的雜草拔掉。

examples.en: Weeds grow fast after a rainy week.
examples.zh: 下過一週的雨之後，雜草長得很快。

examples.en: Grandpa weeds the vegetable garden every weekend.
examples.zh: 爺爺每個週末都會替菜園除草。

examples.en: I need to weed the yard before the party.
examples.zh: 派對前我得先把院子的雜草除掉。

examples.en: They weeded the field in the cool morning.
examples.zh: 他們趁涼爽的早晨替田地除草。

examples.en: She wept when she heard the sad news.
examples.zh: 她聽到這個壞消息時哭了起來。

examples.en: The little boy wept quietly in his room.
examples.zh: 小男孩在房間裡靜靜地流淚。

examples.en: Many people wept at the end of the movie.
examples.zh: 許多人在電影結束時流下了眼淚。

examples.en: Farmers harvest wheat in early summer when the grain is ready.
examples.zh: 農夫在初夏穀粒成熟時收割小麥。

examples.en: Bread is usually made from wheat flour.
examples.zh: 麵包通常是用小麥麵粉做的。

examples.en: The field was full of golden wheat.
examples.zh: 田野裡滿是金黃色的小麥。

examples.en: The rider held a whip in her right hand.
examples.zh: 騎士右手拿著一條鞭子。

examples.en: The trainer used a whip to guide the horse.
examples.zh: 訓練員用鞭子引導那匹馬。

examples.en: An old whip hung on the wall of the barn.
examples.zh: 穀倉的牆上掛著一條舊鞭子。

examples.en: Whip the cream until it becomes thick.
examples.zh: 把鮮奶油攪打到變濃稠。

examples.en: The wind whipped the flags back and forth.
examples.zh: 風把旗子吹得來回飄動。

examples.en: She whipped out her phone to take a photo.
examples.zh: 她迅速掏出手機拍了一張照。

examples.en: The coach blew his whistle to start the game.
examples.zh: 教練吹響哨子，比賽開始。

examples.en: We heard a loud whistle from the train.
examples.zh: 我們聽到火車傳來響亮的汽笛聲。

examples.en: The referee's whistle stopped the match after a player fell.
examples.zh: 一名球員跌倒後，裁判的哨聲讓比賽暫停。

examples.en: He whistles a happy tune while he works.
examples.zh: 他邊工作邊吹著輕快的曲子。

examples.en: The kettle whistled when the water was ready.
examples.zh: 水燒開時，水壺發出了鳴笛聲。

examples.en: My brother whistled for the dog to come back.
examples.zh: 我哥哥吹口哨叫狗回來。

examples.en: The wicked witch in the story cast a spell.
examples.zh: 故事裡邪惡的女巫施了魔法。

examples.en: The wicked stepmother was jealous of the girl.
examples.zh: 壞心的繼母嫉妒那個女孩。

examples.en: Children love stories about wicked kings and brave heroes.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡聽邪惡國王與勇敢英雄的故事。

examples.en: Please wipe the table after dinner with a damp cloth.
examples.zh: 晚餐後請用濕布把桌子擦乾淨。

examples.en: He wiped the sweat off his forehead.
examples.zh: 他擦掉額頭上的汗水。

examples.en: I wiped the old files from my computer.
examples.zh: 我把電腦裡的舊檔案刪除了。

examples.en: Give the counter a quick wipe, please.
examples.zh: 請把檯面快速擦一下。

examples.en: I always carry wipes in my bag for my baby.
examples.zh: 我總是在包包裡帶著濕紙巾給寶寶用。

examples.en: A damp wipe cleaned the screen easily.
examples.zh: 用濕紙巾輕輕一擦就把螢幕擦乾淨了。

examples.en: My grandfather is known for his wisdom.
examples.zh: 我祖父以他的智慧聞名。

examples.en: Wisdom comes from experience as well as books.
examples.zh: 智慧來自經驗，也來自書本。

examples.en: She shared her wisdom with the young students.
examples.zh: 她把自己的智慧分享給年輕的學生。

examples.en: Please wrap the gift in red paper.
examples.zh: 請用紅色紙把禮物包起來。

examples.en: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.
examples.zh: 她把圍巾圍在脖子上。

examples.en: We wrapped the leftover pizza in foil.
examples.zh: 我們用鋁箔紙把吃剩的披薩包起來。

examples.en: Throw the plastic wrap into the trash can.
examples.zh: 把保鮮膜丟進垃圾桶。

examples.en: I ordered a chicken wrap for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐點了一份雞肉捲餅。

examples.en: She wore a warm wrap over her dress.
examples.zh: 她在洋裝外面披了一件保暖的披肩。

examples.en: Separate the yolk from the egg white.
examples.zh: 把蛋黃和蛋白分開。

examples.en: The yolk of a fresh egg is bright yellow.
examples.zh: 新鮮雞蛋的蛋黃是鮮黃色的。

examples.en: He likes his fried egg with a soft yolk.
examples.zh: 他喜歡吃蛋黃半熟的煎蛋。

examples.en: The youngster helped the old man cross the road.
examples.zh: 那個少年幫老先生過馬路。

examples.en: Many youngsters enjoy playing online games with their friends after school.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡放學後和朋友玩線上遊戲。

examples.en: The coach taught the youngsters how to swim.
examples.zh: 教練教這群孩子怎麼游泳。

examples.en: The zipper on my jacket is stuck.
examples.zh: 我外套的拉鍊卡住了。

examples.en: Please close the zipper of your backpack.
examples.zh: 請把你後背包的拉鍊拉上。

examples.en: She fixed the broken zipper with a pin.
examples.zh: 她用別針修好了壞掉的拉鍊。

examples.en: This is a no-parking zone, so please move your car.
examples.zh: 這裡是禁止停車的區域，請把車移走。

examples.en: Students must stay in the safe zone during the drill.
examples.zh: 演習期間，學生必須待在安全區域。

examples.en: The city has a new school zone near the station.
examples.zh: 這座城市在車站附近新劃設了學校周邊交通安全區。

examples.en: The city zoned this area for new homes.
examples.zh: 市政府把這個地區劃為住宅用地。

examples.en: The land was zoned for farming only.
examples.zh: 這塊土地只劃定為農業用途。

examples.en: They zoned the park for public use.
examples.zh: 他們把這座公園劃為公共使用區。

examples.en: I added some almonds to my breakfast cereal.
examples.zh: 我在早餐麥片裡加了一些杏仁。

examples.en: The cake is topped with sliced almonds.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕上面撒了杏仁片。

examples.en: Almond milk is popular with people who avoid dairy.
examples.zh: 杏仁奶很受不食用乳製品的人歡迎。

examples.en: You need a comma after the word 'however' in this sentence.
examples.zh: 這個句子裡，在「however」後面需要加逗號。

examples.en: Our teacher showed us where to put a comma.
examples.zh: 老師示範給我們看逗號該放在哪裡。

examples.en: A comma separates items in a list.
examples.zh: 逗號用來分隔清單中的各個品項。

senses.zh: 控制器；管制員；財務主管

examples.en: He lost the game controller under the sofa.
examples.zh: 他把遊戲控制器弄丟在沙發底下了。

examples.en: The air traffic controller guided the plane to land.
examples.zh: 空中交通管制員引導飛機降落。

examples.en: The company's financial controller checks every report.
examples.zh: 公司的財務主管會審閱每一份報告。

examples.en: An apple is a countable thing, so you can say two apples.
examples.zh: 蘋果是可數的東西，所以可以說兩顆蘋果。

examples.en: Water is not countable, so we measure it in liters.
examples.zh: 水是不可數的，所以我們用公升來計量。

examples.en: The number of visitors is easily countable.
examples.zh: 訪客的人數很容易計算。

examples.en: The car dealer offered us a good price.
examples.zh: 汽車經銷商給了我們一個不錯的價格。

examples.en: My uncle is an antique dealer in Tainan.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是台南的古董商。

examples.en: The dealer handed each player five cards.
examples.zh: 發牌員發給每位玩家五張牌。

examples.en: The river deepens near the bridge, so swimmers should be careful.
examples.zh: 河水在橋附近變深，因此游泳的人應該小心。

examples.en: Working together on the school play helped deepen their friendship.
examples.zh: 一起參與校園戲劇的工作，使他們的友誼更加深厚。

examples.en: The crisis deepened as prices kept rising.
examples.zh: 隨著物價持續上漲，危機也加深了。

senses.zh: 表情豐富的；有表現力的

examples.en: She has big, expressive eyes that reveal how she feels.
examples.zh: 她有一雙大而富有表情的眼睛，能流露出她的感受。

examples.en: The dancer gave an expressive performance that moved the entire audience.
examples.zh: 那位舞者的表演很有感染力，感動了全場觀眾。

examples.en: My dog has a very expressive face.
examples.zh: 我的狗臉上的表情非常豐富。

examples.en: The child was fearful of the dark.
examples.zh: 那個孩子很怕黑。

examples.en: She felt fearful before her first speech.
examples.zh: 她在第一次演講前感到害怕。

examples.en: Many people are fearful about losing their jobs.
examples.zh: 許多人擔心會失業。

examples.en: A grasshopper jumped onto the leaf and began to eat.
examples.zh: 一隻蚱蜢跳到葉子上，開始進食。

examples.en: We saw a green grasshopper in the garden.
examples.zh: 我們在花園裡看到一隻綠色的蚱蜢。

examples.en: The grasshopper can jump far with its strong legs.
examples.zh: 蚱蜢可以靠強壯的後腿跳得很遠。

examples.en: The children played on the grassy hill.
examples.zh: 孩子們在長滿草的山坡上玩耍。

examples.en: We had a picnic on a grassy field.
examples.zh: 我們在一片草地上野餐。

examples.en: A grassy path led to the small lake.
examples.zh: 一條長滿草的小徑通往那座小湖。

senses.zh: 令人厭惡的；充滿惡意的

examples.en: He said some hateful things to his sister.
examples.zh: 他對妹妹說了一些很傷人的話。

examples.en: Bullying is a hateful act that can seriously hurt others.
examples.zh: 霸凌是令人厭惡的行為，可能會嚴重傷害他人。

examples.en: She could not forget the hateful message.
examples.zh: 她無法忘記那則充滿惡意的訊息。

examples.en: Each ticket holder can bring one guest.
examples.zh: 每位持票人可以帶一位客人。

examples.en: I bought a new pen holder for my desk.
examples.zh: 我為書桌買了一個新的筆筒。

examples.en: The cup holder in the car is too small.
examples.zh: 車上的杯架太小了。

examples.en: The little girl licked a red lollipop.
examples.zh: 小女孩舔著一支紅色棒棒糖。

examples.en: The dentist gave each kid a lollipop.
examples.zh: 牙醫給每個小孩一支棒棒糖。

examples.en: He bought a strawberry lollipop at the store.
examples.zh: 他在商店買了一支草莓口味的棒棒糖。

examples.en: My father wears a necktie to work.
examples.zh: 我父親打著領帶去上班。

examples.en: He bought a blue necktie for the interview.
examples.zh: 他為了面試買了一條藍色領帶。

examples.en: Can you help me tie my necktie?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我打領帶嗎？

senses.zh: 持續進行的；仍在進行的

examples.en: The ongoing road work causes traffic jams.
examples.zh: 持續進行的道路施工造成塞車。

examples.en: We have an ongoing project with a big client.
examples.zh: 我們正在和一位大客戶合作進行專案。

examples.en: The police said the investigation is ongoing.
examples.zh: 警方表示調查仍在進行中。

senses.zh: 愛玩的；頑皮的；開玩笑的

examples.en: The playful puppy ran around the yard.
examples.zh: 那隻頑皮的小狗在院子裡跑來跑去。

examples.en: She gave her brother a playful push.
examples.zh: 她開玩笑地推了弟弟一下。

examples.en: He is in a playful mood this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上玩興很濃。

examples.en: The museum has a beautiful collection of porcelain.
examples.zh: 這座博物館有一批精美的瓷器收藏。

examples.en: This cup is made of fine white porcelain.
examples.zh: 這個杯子是用上等的白瓷做成的。

examples.en: She wrapped each piece of porcelain carefully before moving house.
examples.zh: 她搬家前仔細包好每一件瓷器。

examples.en: The old house had a queer smell.
examples.zh: 那棟老房子有股怪味。

examples.en: He gave me a queer look when I asked.
examples.zh: 我開口問的時候，他古怪地看了我一眼。

examples.en: The library displayed books by queer writers during its diversity event.
examples.zh: 圖書館在多元文化活動期間展示酷兒作家的書籍。

examples.en: Use a damp rag to clean the window.
examples.zh: 用濕抹布擦窗戶。

examples.en: He wiped his hands on an old rag.
examples.zh: 他在一塊舊布上擦了擦手。

examples.en: The mechanic kept a rag in his pocket.
examples.zh: 那位技師口袋裡放著一塊抹布。

examples.en: I hope to visit Japan someday and explore its historic temples.
examples.zh: 我希望有一天能去日本，探索當地具有歷史意義的寺廟。

examples.en: Someday you will understand why I said that.
examples.zh: 有一天你會明白我為什麼那樣說。

examples.en: She dreams of opening her own bakery someday.
examples.zh: 她夢想著有一天能開一家自己的烘焙坊。

examples.en: The bread went stale after two days.
examples.zh: 麵包放了兩天就不新鮮了。

examples.en: The room smelled of stale air because the windows were closed.
examples.zh: 房間的窗戶都關著，空氣聞起來很悶濁。

examples.en: These jokes are stale; we have heard them before.
examples.zh: 這些笑話太老套了，我們以前聽過。

examples.en: The underlying cause of the problem is poor planning.
examples.zh: 問題的根本原因是規劃不佳。

examples.en: The doctor looked for an underlying illness.
examples.zh: 醫生找尋潛在的疾病。

examples.en: We need to understand the underlying idea first.
examples.zh: 我們得先理解其背後的基本概念。

examples.en: They plan to wed in the spring.
examples.zh: 他們打算在春天結婚。

examples.en: The couple wed in a small church.
examples.zh: 這對佳偶在一間小教堂裡結了婚。

examples.en: She wed her childhood friend last year.
examples.zh: 她去年嫁給了青梅竹馬的朋友。

examples.en: The guard was armed with a radio and a flashlight.
examples.zh: 警衛配備了一支無線電和一支手電筒。

examples.en: The soldiers returned to the armed forces base.
examples.zh: 士兵們回到了武裝部隊的基地。

examples.en: Armed with a map, we found the old temple.
examples.zh: 我們憑藉著一張地圖，找到了那間老廟。

examples.en: I need to change the bulb in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我得換掉廚房的燈泡。

examples.en: Plant the tulip bulbs in the fall.
examples.zh: 鬱金香的鱗莖要在秋天種下。

examples.en: The bulb burned out suddenly last night.
examples.zh: 這個燈泡昨晚突然燒壞了。

examples.en: The school keeps student records in a database.
examples.zh: 學校把學生的資料存在資料庫裡。

examples.en: She searched the database for the missing file.
examples.zh: 她在資料庫裡搜尋遺失的檔案。

examples.en: Our company is building a new customer database.
examples.zh: 我們公司正在建立新的客戶資料庫。

examples.en: My house is farther from school than yours.
examples.zh: 我家離學校比你家更遠。

examples.en: We walked farther along the beach to find a quiet spot.
examples.zh: 我們沿著海灘走得更遠，想找一個安靜的地方。

examples.en: She moved farther away from the stage.
examples.zh: 她往離舞台更遠的地方移動。

examples.en: The farther shore was hard to see.
examples.zh: 更遠的那一岸很難看清楚。

examples.en: Go to the farther end of the hall.
examples.zh: 請走到走廊較遠的那一端。

examples.en: The farther station is about ten minutes away.
examples.zh: 較遠的那個車站大約要十分鐘。

examples.en: The class is mostly girls this year.
examples.zh: 今年班上大部分是女生。

examples.en: We mostly eat rice for dinner, but sometimes we have noodles.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐大多吃米飯，但有時會吃麵。

examples.en: The park was mostly empty on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 週一早上，公園幾乎沒什麼人。

examples.en: It is freezing outside, so wear a coat.
examples.zh: 外面冷得要命，所以要穿外套。

examples.en: The water in the lake was freezing.
examples.zh: 湖裡的水冷得刺骨。

examples.en: I was freezing after waiting at the bus stop for an hour.
examples.zh: 我在公車站牌等了一個小時，冷得要命。

examples.en: The temperature fell below freezing last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚氣溫降到了冰點以下。

examples.en: Freezing can change the taste of some foods.
examples.zh: 冷凍可能會改變某些食物的味道。

examples.en: The pipes broke because of freezing during the unusually cold winter.
examples.zh: 在那個異常寒冷的冬天，水管因結冰而破裂。

examples.en: We were touched by her goodness when she helped our family.
examples.zh: 她幫助我們一家人時，我們被她的善良感動。

examples.en: The soup is full of healthy goodness.
examples.zh: 這碗湯充滿了健康的營養。

examples.en: He believes in the goodness of people.
examples.zh: 他相信人性本善。

examples.en: Goodness, I forgot my wallet and cannot pay for lunch!
examples.zh: 天啊，我忘了帶錢包，沒辦法付午餐錢！

examples.en: Goodness, it is already ten o'clock, and I haven't finished my homework!
examples.zh: 天啊，已經十點了，我還沒寫完功課！

examples.en: My goodness, you have grown so tall!
examples.zh: 我的天啊，你長這麼高了！

examples.en: It is important to be kind to oneself.
examples.zh: 對自己好是很重要的。

examples.en: One should take care of oneself when sick.
examples.zh: 生病時要好好照顧自己。

examples.en: It is hard to teach oneself a new language.
examples.zh: 自學一種新語言是很難的。
